newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golf-Woosnam confirms entry for Heineken Classic.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Woosnam confirms entry for Heineken Classic.

text.p: Former U.S. Masters golf champion Ian Woosnam on Tuesday confirmed he would play in the Heineken Classic in Perth next January.
Woosnam, who won the 1991 Masters at Augusta, has told Classic organisers he would return in a bid to reclaim the Heineken title he won in 1996.
The A$1.3 million (US$962,000) Classic is Australia's richest golf tournament.
"Each year our field has improved enormously and I expect 1988 to be our best yet," tournament director Tony Roosenburg said in a statement.
